title: Phi-3 Technical Report
before: Small models were assumed to be weak, and useful mainly for cheap tasks.
problem: Phones and laptops cannot run a 70B model, but their users want capable assistance.
breakthrough: A 3.8B model trained on heavily filtered and synthetic data, performing near models ten times its size.
why: It pushed the data-quality thesis to its edge and made on-device assistants credible.
next: The phi series continued; every lab now ships a small model tuned on synthetic data.
inherits: On-device capability through data curation rather than scale.
